completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-44-2023-E-ELECTRICITY-FEES-REGULATIONS-2023.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Electricity (FeesJ Regulations, 2023 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st January 2023. Fees

(1J The fees specified in the Schedule shall be payable to the Authority in respect of the matters to which they relate. (21 Such fees shall be payable in advance and shall not be refundable.

SCHEDULE (regulation 2) FEES Type of electricity licence Fee payable Generation licence I. Annual licence $0.80 for each kW of generation installed capacity

Replacement for loss or damage of licence $100. Made this 12th. day of Safar, 1445 Hijriah corresponding to the 29th. day of August, 2023. PEHIN DATU LAILARAJA MAJOR GENERAL (RETIRED) DATO PADUKA SERI

HAJI A WANG HALBI BIN HAJI MOHD YUSSOF Minister in the Office of the Prime Minister and Minister of Defence II.
